examples.arabic: كان الجو غائم بفصل الخريف فقررت امي تاخدنا على المول لنشتري تياب
examples.english: The weather was cloudy in the autumn season, so my mom decided to take us to the mall to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: kan el jaw ghaem bfasl el kharif fqararet emi takhedna ala el mall laneshtri tyab

examples.arabic: فتت ع محل كبير وقست كتير تياب شتوية بتجنن
examples.english: I entered a big shop and tried on many amazing winter clothes.
examples.transliteration: Fetet aa mahal kbeer w qeset kteer tyab shetwiyeh betjannen

examples.arabic: اليوم أنا محتاجة تياب جديدة لأنو تيابي القديمة صغيرة
examples.english: Today I need new clothes because my old clothes are small.
examples.transliteration: Elyom ana mehtaja tiyab jdeede lianno tiyabi el adeeme sagheera

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما قالت سارة بحب يلا نروح نشتري تياب جديدة
examples.english: "Good morning, Mama," said Sarah lovingly. "Let's go buy new clothes."
examples.transliteration: Sabāḥ al-khayr ya mama qālat Sāra bi ḥubb yalla nrūḥ nishtarī tyāb jdīde.

examples.arabic: اليوم بلشت ابكر عشان بدي اشتري تياب جديدة
examples.english: Today I started early because I want to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: El yom ballashat abkar ashan biddi ashtari tiyab jedide.

examples.arabic: اليوم عيلتي بدها تشتري تياب جديدة
examples.english: Today my family wants to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: El-yōm ʿēltī biddha tashtarī tiyāb jdīdē.
